mechanism: Sertraline may increase hyponatremia risk and torsemide can cause electrolyte depletion; combined use increases risk of hyponatremia and hypokalemia, particularly with SIADH from SSRI.
action: Monitor serum sodium and potassium levels regularly; assess hydration status and adjust torsemide dosing if needed; consider alternative diuretic if severe hyponatremia develops.
